st: The Lasagna Zone/Sleepytime Pig/Yojumbo
d: When Garfield has an accident on the new satellite antennae, he ends up in the TV./Orson Can't get to sleep./Jon decides to learn karate.

st: All Things Fat and Small/Robin Hog/Hare Replacement
d: Jon goes river rafting./Orson gets caught up in his book on the bandit of Sherwood./Jon's magic act runs into trouble.

st: Return of the Buddy Bears/Much Ado About Lanolin/Reigning Cats and Dogs
d: The Buddy Bears help Garfield clean the house./Orson and the gang do a performance of "Taming of the Shrew."/Garfield hosts a TV debate.

st: Star Struck/Election Daze/Dirty Business
d: Garfield writes his own script for the show./The weasel convinces Roy to suggest an election./Jon visits his cousin Berferd.

st: Basket Brawl/The Origin of Power Pig/Cactus Jake Rides Again
d: Jon, Odie & Nermal's attempt to go on a picnic./Orson tells how he became Power Pig./Cactus Jake moves in with Jon.

st: Binky Gets Cancelled/Show Stoppers/Cutie and the Beast
d: Binky the Clown loses his show and gets a job fixing up Jon's house./The farm's talent show is disrupted when Orson's brothers show./Nermal thinks it is no longer the "world's cutest kitten."

st: Rip Van Kitty/Grabbity/The Big Catnap
d: Garfield sleeps for twenty years and awakens to a strange future./Roy convinces Wade that the "law of gravity" has been repealed./The arrival of homemade cookies signal a "cat and mouse" game.

st: Garfield His 9 Lives
d: This sometimes very funny and sometimes highly emotional anthology follows Garfield's nine lives throughout history, from his first life as a prehistoric cat-Neanderthal to his ninth life as an astronaut in a jam.
Garfield sits on Jon’s book and refuses to get up. Garfield thwarts a bank robbery.

st: First Class Feline/Hamelot/How to be funny
d: Garfield's plan to send Nermal to Abu Dhabi fails./Orson dreams about the knights of the round table./Garfield lectures on what humor is.

st: Galactic Gamesman Garfield/Sly Spy Guy/The Thing That Stayed Forever
d: Garfield is consumed playing a video game, while Jon is having a terrible stomachache. Orson can't find his spy novel and slips into one of his fantasies. The Arbuckle household is in distress when Jon's overweight uncle comes for a long visit.

st: Identity Crisis/U.S. Acres: The Bad Sport/Up a Tree
d: Garfield imitates dogs and mice./The gang plays "pig ball."/Garfield climbs a tree.
Garfield discovers Jon’s new ventriloquist dummy is alive. Jon decides to take up skydiving.

st: Attention-Getting Garfield/Swine Trek/Dog Food
d: Floyd, the mouse, shows Garfield how to get noticed./Orson dreams he is captain of a starship./Garfield tells Odie how they make dog food.

st: Garfield’s Babes & Bullets
d: Garfield the cat daydreams that he's an old-time private detective.

st: Odielocks/Quack to the Future/Beddy Buy
d: Garfield tells the story about Odielocks, and the three bears./Orson wishes he had a time machine./When Garfield breaks his bed, Jon buys a new one.
Garfield tells the story of the Pied Piper of Hamlin, who has a cat.

st: Sludge Monster/Fortune Kooky/Heatwave Holiday
d: Jon, Garfield and Odie spend the night in a spooky hotel./Orson tries to convince Wade that fortune cookies aren't accurate./On a hot summer day, Garfield brings out the Christmas decorations.

st: Speed Trap/Flights of Fantasy/Castaway Cat
d: Jon gets a speeding ticket from a phony cop and decides to protest in court. Orson teaches Wade how by using one's imagination, anything is possible. Garfield is reliving Robinson Crusoe while Jon persuades a repairman to fix the cable.

st: TV of Tomorrow/Little Red Riding Egg/The Well Fed Feline
d: Jon buys a new TV set when his old one breaks./Orson decides to make his own movie./Animal activist thinks Garfield is starving.
Mr. Swindler returns and gets Jon to sell the house for $1. Wade’s forgetful cousin arrives.
Jon gets to meet Vivacia, the TV horror show hostess of his dreams. Wade Duck is caught in a 60-minute style interview.

st: Clean Sweep/Secrets of the Animated Cartoon/How the West was Lost
d: Jon gets an automatic dog washer./Orson gives a lecture on cartoon rules and logic./Garfield comes to the rescue when Cactus Jake is fired.

st: Box O' Fun/U.S Acres: Unidentified Flying Orson/School Daze
d: Garfield plays in an empty cardboard box./Orson's science fiction book inspires Roy to play a trick./Jon sends Garfield to a school for cats run by an ex-Marine.

st: Night of the Living Laundromat/Fast Food/Cash and Carry
d: Jon buys a washing machine that is actually alive and eats his clothes. Bo is the slowest cook ever, and Roy opens a fast food joint. Jon cancels all his credit cards and takes Garfield and Odie to the mall to buy a new waste-basket.

st: Count Lasagna/Mystery Guest/Rodent Rampage
d: Jon tries to sell a story about a vampire and his cat./Roy holds a phone-in contest./Garfield won't chase mice.
Garfield is adopted by an elderly lady. Roy buys a robot that creates weather.

st: Garfield Gets a Life
d: Garfield and his owner are in a rut. Jon cannot seem to get a date, until a school for the personality impaired opens a new window of opportunity for Jon, but is shut tight for Garfield.
The ancestor of one of the most hungry pirates sets sail. Philo is back to help give motivational speeches to the weasel and Wade.
Garfield and Odie trick Jon into not taking a trip on his vacation.

st: Wonderful World/Orson Awards/Garfield Workout
d: Jon, Garfield and Odie head to the Wonder World amusement park./Roy and Orson's brothers scheme to get the big award./Garfield shows some of his favorite exercises.

st: Best of Breed/U.S. Acres: National Tapioca Pudding Day/All About Odie
d: Garfield and Nermal are the finalists in a big cat show./Roy invents a holiday./Garfield tries to lecture an audience about himself.
Garfield and Penelope imagine what it would be like to be married.

st: Bouncing Baby Blues/The Ugly Duckling/Learning Lessons
d: Garfield and Odie grab the wrong shopping cart with a baby inside. Orson narrates "The Ugly Duckling" with Wade as the star. When the network asks for an educational segment, the Buddy Bears are brought in, causing Garfield to struggle.
